title: Model routing got a quieter cleanup
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: cleaner model plumbing, a living app directory, and the right people and signals back where they belong.

DeepSeek and Portkey endpoints and model mappings were refactored, while available-model handlers now use direct references instead of an extra indirection layer. Same one-endpoint model access, with fewer moving parts underneath.

The dev apps list is now backed by a dynamic Google Sheet, making it easier to keep track of what the community is building without maintaining a static inventory by hand.

MCPollinations received its correct project attribution, missing affiliates were added to the registry, and ad-skip analytics were restored after taking an accidental detour out of the codebase.
